prompt:
Login page for '油擎智安 · 吊装安全运营平台' (QingAn Smart Lift, a crane/hoisting safety operations monitoring platform). Desktop 1920x1080, split layout, ALL text in Simplified Chinese. DARK industrial SCADA aesthetic with these exact colors: page background #060d1a, panels #0d1b30, inner panels #122340, borders #1e3a5c, primary text #e8f1fd, secondary text #8ba3c2, muted #55708f, brand blue #3b82f6, tech cyan accent #22d3ee, gold #eab308. Font: Noto Sans SC.

LEFT SIDE (~55% width): hero brand panel with a full-bleed background photo of an industrial crane at a construction site at dusk, covered by a deep navy gradient overlay (dark at left, lighter at right) plus a subtle cyan 48px grid-line texture. Top-left: brand lockup — a shield-shaped badge logo in navy blue with gold border containing a crane hook (metallic gold and blue, industrial IoT style), next to it product name '油擎智安' (large, white, letter-spaced) with subtitle '吊装安全运营平台 · QING-AN SMART LIFT' in small muted text. Center: a small cyan pill badge '◈ 智能吊装 · 安全护航', then huge bold headline '重新定义吊装安全的技术边界' with the word '吊装安全' highlighted in cyan #22d3ee, subheadline '不止看见现场，更能感知运动、距离与三维空间风险。' in soft light blue. Bottom: three glassmorphism feature rows with icon chips (blue tinted): '雷达感知 · 毫米级运动与距离测算', '三维空间风险建模 · 电子围栏预警', '风险事件全流程闭环 · 数据可视化'.

RIGHT SIDE (~45%): form pane on #0d1b30 with left border #1e3a5c. Top row: pill tab switcher (登录 active on blue gradient / 注册 inactive) on the left, and a circular sun/moon theme-toggle icon button top right. Middle: heading '欢迎回来' (32px bold), hint '输入您的账号信息，继续守护每一次安全吊装。', field '账号 / 手机号' with user icon and placeholder '请输入您的账号信息', field '登录密码' with lock icon, placeholder and eye toggle. Row with checkbox '记住登录状态' and link '忘记密码？' (blue). Full-width primary button '立即登录 →' with blue gradient #3b82f6→#1d4ed8, glow shadow, letter-spaced bold white text. Below: centered '还没有账号？立即注册' with blue link, and tiny footer '© 2026 油擎智安 · 吊装安全运营平台'. NO third-party/social login icons anywhere.
